'''Adapted Tozoons''' are a type of unique [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites]] tier. 

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns after a [[Primitive Tozoon]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Adapted Tozoons are Fast-Burrowing Melee Combatants. They are able to burrow underground to ambush their prey, they are completely invulnerable while underground.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Adapted Tozoons, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
